Photo 1: Front view of the same camera, showing the lens with 'E 3.5-5.6/PZ 16-50 OSS' clearly readable. The flip-out screen is extended and shows a live view of the hand holding the camera. The screen displays camera settings: 1/160, F2.8, ISO 400, 100%.
